messages:
maria_ml: Heads-up — I'm pushing Ceres-2 (cost-optimized variant) through serving readiness checks today. Weights live at s3://redwood-models/ceres/ceres-2/v1/weights.pt — PTAL infra + runtime. Planning a doc + customer announcement once we clear: tokenizer sanity, config validation, canary rollout policy.

 danp: Confirmed I can see the S3 path and started a dry run load on a dedicated instance. No immediate missing tensors. I'll run the usual KV cache stress test and small-batch latency sweep. ETA ~30m.

 ashley_docs: Thanks — I'll draft the customer-facing blurb but need capability bullets and any known quirks. Short list please: strengths, limits, and recommended route names.

 julien_ml: Quick note on tokenizer: the shipped sentencepiece model lowercases punctuation in a few edge cases (e.g., "U.S.A." -> "u . s . a ."). It affects exact-match reranking. Workaround: set tokenizer.normalize_punct=false in our loader or use the legacy fast-tokenizer build. Patch incoming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/412 (small loader change + unit tests).

 maria_ml: @julien_ml good catch. Can you add a short example for the docs demonstrating before/after tokenization? Ashley — that'll go in the quirks section.

 danp: Also found one config nit: serving-config expects `serve_variant` keys to map to gpu-allocs. The new model had a stray tab in the YAML which made the canary mapping fail in CI. Fixed in the branch I'm running now. Sample config I used:

 ```yaml
 model_name: ceres-2
 weights_s3: s3://redwood-models/ceres/ceres-2/v1/weights.pt
 tokenizer: sentencepiece-unigram
 quantize: int8
 serve_variant: hosted-cost-opt
 canary:
   - region: us-west-2
     percent: 5
     gpu_alloc: 1
 ```

 infra-bot: CI status: models/ceres-2 branch — build ✅, integration tests running (kv-cache, batcher, tokenizer). See https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/1234

 carol_releasemgr: For naming — customer-facing name should be "ceres-2 (cost-optimized)" and internal route name `ceres-2-costopt`. Keeps things clear for billing dashboards. Any objections?

 ashley_docs: No objections. I'll use that phrasing in the announcement and add a short table: recommended route -> latency/cost profile -> suggested use cases. Could you supply a 1-line capability for the top of the doc? e.g., "good at instruction-following, tuned for short form generation, tradeoff: some punctuation tokenization oddities"

 julien_ml: Proposed capability line looks fine. Add note: evaluation on multi-turn coherency is OK up to 1024 tokens; beyond that you may see repetition without KV cache warmup.

 danp: Canary plan: 5% us-west-2, fallback policy to ceres-1 if latency > 300ms p50 or error rate > 1% for 5m. Can set auto-rollbacks in the console.

 sre_oncall: FYI — when you enable auto-rollbacks pls include an alert runbook link. I added a basic runbook: https://playbooks.redwood-inference/internal/canary-rollbacks (will expand for this release).

 maria_ml: Great progress. Action items: julien add tokenization examples to PR 412; danp merge the config fix and attach canary policy; ashley draft announcement (I'll review); carol coordinate release window. Plan: aim for public docs + announcement tomorrow EOD if all green.

 ashley_docs: Drafting now. Will ping for sign-off when the PRs land.

 danp: CI finished — integration tests passed, small-batch latency within target. Merging config fix now.

 infra-bot: Deploy job started for canary (ceres-2-costopt) in us-west-2 at 1772501400.

 carol_releasemgr: Scheduling announcement: hold at 12:00 PDT tomorrow — I'll send calendar invite to docs/marketing/sales.

 julien_ml: PR 412 updated with tokenization examples and a short note about when to switch to fast-tokenizer.

 ashley_docs: Received. Draft announcement link: https://docs.redwood-inference.internal/releases/ceres-2-draft (WIP). PTAL @maria_ml @carol_releasemgr

 maria_ml: PTAL now, left a few tiny wording suggestions. Otherwise :shipit: once PRs merged.

 danp: Merged — canary live. Monitoring.

 sre_oncall: Canary healthy at 10m mark. No rollbacks triggered.

 ashley_docs: I'll queue the announcement for 12:00 PDT. Final check: add the tokenizer quirk bullet and the recommended fallback (ceres-1).

 maria_ml: Perfect. Thanks team — excellent coordination.
